observations: Black game console with a blue power indicator light on the right side.
A black Xbox controller is resting on top of the console.
The console is sitting on a white table with a 'DYNAMITE' sticker visible.
A computer monitor is visible in the background, but its screen is not clearly legible.
The console has a matte finish with horizontal lines on the top surface.
The console is connected to a power cable and a cable to a computer or TV.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the console menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the Xbox Live service.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's 'System' settings showing the account status.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the console menu.
Screenshot of the console's system settings showing the account status.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
